name: Toshokan
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional public library: a summer reading campaign, a first day as a shelving volunteer, a trial online reservation system for study rooms, volunteer training plans, a staffer teaching the booking system to a newcomer, an essay on why the reservation system started, a priority-day scheduling rule, and a one-year report on how it changed the library. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
